notes:
**Less ghosting on the Library screen.** When a dialog closes over the Library (an update, Library Sync, backup and so on), or you come back to it from another screen, it now gives the screen a quick refresh so the dialog's outline doesn't linger.

**A cleaner logo on the second tablet.** When the master goes to its Library, the second tablet now clears its screen a second time under the logo, so the last page of music no longer shows faintly behind it.

If you use two tablets together, update both.
